title: Bad Trips Guide, Round 62
intro: Round 62 (2026-11-27). Your three round-61 answers are in. Your own B155 went in whole: you had checked it [by itself](https://www.pangram.com/history/00eb45f1-8b99-4337-929b-b4489859cf23) and [with the paragraph before it](https://www.pangram.com/history/54b91410-ee03-4ebe-969b-03777505918f), both Human High in one window, and with the ozone paragraph after it, it reads [Human High in one window](https://www.pangram.com/history/dc4e6e82-d4cd-49cc-a0e0-14ede9962595) through the API too. Activated Charcoal is in as my version (your "a"), and from now on the warning check frees a line whose only warning word is no caution, each one named with its reason. I read your FROM-POST answer as (a), so the 5g line stays out, and the rubbing line now says "zeolite mixed in water" ([Human High by itself](https://www.pangram.com/history/e067e728-1f20-4c3f-bf99-96430965defd)). [Each point and where it went](https://github.com/u-dont-existDOTcom/joel-articles/blob/main/articles/bad-trips/review/r61/RESULTS-R61.md).

With your B155 in, the whole of ZeoCharge & Ferment reads [Human High in one window](https://www.pangram.com/history/7447e8b4-1a7f-46f0-bf4b-c33046e98efe), so its three short lines needed no change. Then Beach Morning Glory: as it stood it read AI ([its last two paragraphs](https://www.pangram.com/history/55e4ae84-ccba-40f7-9156-b6a358c99a43)). Every paragraph of my rewrite reads Human High by itself or with a neighbour, and the section reads [Human](https://www.pangram.com/history/e1629a55-218a-4f9a-a755-c7cdced59265), with some windows still at Medium and one at Low, which I keep working on. Two things in it only you can say are the cards below ([every check](https://github.com/u-dont-existDOTcom/joel-articles/blob/main/articles/bad-trips/humanize/h80-20261127/RESULTS.md); [what is left](https://github.com/u-dont-existDOTcom/joel-articles/blob/main/articles/bad-trips/humanize/h80-20261127/LEFT.md)).

suggestions.title: 1. Beach Morning Glory: what does the juice do when it touches your skin?
suggestions.whose: the post's paragraph, drafted by a model from his practice, rewritten in turn 72 (Human High with the paragraph before it)
suggestions.question:
The handling line says even picking a leaf "can affect me" when the juice from the broken part touches sensitive skin, especially under the fingernails. A fresh reader couldn't tell what that effect is.
(a) you feel the plant's effect, as you would from eating some (a trip starts to end); (b) a skin reaction, like a rash or a sting; or say it as you'd say it, and it goes into that sentence.
suggestions.why: a sitter who picks or breaks leaves needs to know what to watch for in themselves
suggestions.stays: the line as it reads now (highlighted), which is in the guide
suggestions.advice_note: (a) or (b), or the effect as you'd describe it: I can't tell which from your post

suggestions.title: 2. Beach Morning Glory: how big is the nibble for nausea?
suggestions.whose: the post's paragraph, drafted by a model from his practice, rewritten in turn 72 (Human High by itself)
suggestions.question:
A fresh reader sitting with a friend couldn't judge "a tiny nibble" against the amount that ends a trip, and the paragraph says it takes only a little more than a nibble to end one, so a sitter could easily give too much.
How big is the nibble you'd give for nausea? Write it as you'd say it, as something a sitter can see (a part of a leaf, say), and it goes into that sentence. Or (a): leave it as "a tiny nibble".
suggestions.why: the amount is yours, and a sitter who guesses too big ends the trip they meant to keep going
suggestions.stays: the paragraph as it reads now (highlighted), which is in the guide
suggestions.advice_note: a size you'd name: the whole leaf now comes first, so the reader has one amount to judge by, but not the nibble's
